effect:
A Ball for weaker Pokémon.

Catch rate scales with how low level the target is. Under level 20 its nearly 4x, but at level 30+ its no better than a regular Poké Ball.

I use these when going back to early routes to fill out the dex. Makes quick work of stuff you skipped.
